usage: new_adr.py [-h] --title TITLE [--status {proposed,accepted}]
                  [--version VERSION] [--subsystem SUBSYSTEM]
                  [--supersedes SUPERSEDES] [--amends AMENDS] [--dir DIR]

Create the next Architecture Decision Record

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --title TITLE         Decision title, without version numbers
  --status {proposed,accepted}
                        Initial status
  --version VERSION     Version that ships the decision (e.g. v0.46.0)
  --subsystem SUBSYSTEM
                        Comma-separated subsystem page names (e.g. rag,onnx)
  --supersedes SUPERSEDES
                        Comma-separated ADR numbers this one replaces entirely
  --amends AMENDS       Comma-separated ADR numbers this one corrects in part
  --dir DIR             Project directory (default: current; the Git root is
                        used)
